findings.location: Proof, step 3.1: the passage from finite-stack Mayer–Vietoris sequences to their direct limit.
findings.evidence: The cited Mayer–Vietoris result establishes exactness for an open cover, but this step does not prove or cite exactness of the filtered direct limit. The finite-support observation alone does not establish the kernel/image passage. An elementwise finite-stack argument or a citation to exactness of filtered colimits of abelian groups closes this short gap.

findings.location: Proof, step 1.1: the assertion that nested disk interiors are disjoint after placing disks at distinct nearby heights.
findings.evidence: The proof does not describe a boundary-fixed embedding of the nested disk sheets in S³; their boundary circles must remain in the projection sphere for the bands to attach. The disk-region supplier and algorithm provide planar disks and the height-placement instruction, but not the cap construction. Smooth height functions vanishing on each boundary and ordered to separate nested sheets would close this nonfatal geometric step.
